title: The Diagonal Amos-Type Family at Real Order: a Machine-Checked Quantitative Crossing Classification
abstract: We formalize the diagonal Amos-type family for the modified Bessel ratio at real nonnegative order. The classical upper and lower bounding regimes are attributed to existing results. For parameters strictly between the sharp endpoints, the formal development establishes a unique transversal crossing, an explicit location window, a strict threshold, and a two-sided scale law. The revision corrects artifact provenance and witness descriptions and distinguishes historical certified numerical evidence from formal results. No new Lean build is claimed for this revision.
